title: The Orchard of Grafted Light
author: Barış Kısır
short_description: A runaway joins a traveling fair that grows glass apples from grafted memories, then learns her own past was pruned to plant its orchard.
long_description: In a valley where grief is currency, the traveling Lamplight Fair tends a miraculous orchard of glass apples grown from grafted human memories. Runaway Wren Halloway joins as a tender only to learn the trees hunger for whole lives, and her own past was pruned to feed them. As the fair's dazzling master plans a mass harvest in plague-scarred Graywater, Wren must master a forbidden gentler graft with the help of an exiled keeper and a guilt-ridden mapmaker. To free the valley's stolen yesterdays, she must risk grafting away the last of herself.
main_characters: Wren Halloway - runaway graft-tender's apprentice who hears voices trapped inside unripe glass fruit
Master Corvin Vell - charismatic fair-master who bottles traded memories and feeds whole lives to his trees
Nan Pricket - exiled orchard-keeper who knows the forbidden true graft that shares without stealing
Silas Quill - debt-bound fair mapmaker charting towns that forgot themselves after the fair moved on
